intro.h2: Paint and renovation work that makes a house look new again
paragraphs: C4 Renovations, LLC handles interior and exterior painting in Buford, GA, along with other renovation work around the house. One homeowner first hired Chris to repaint the inside of her home after a flood. A year later she called him back for the outside, and he painted the entire house in four days, communicating throughout.

Other customers talk about the planning. One says Chris was insightful about how colors would look in different rooms based on lighting and location, patient with their changes and finished within the timeline he first gave. Another family had their basement painted and says it looks like a brand new area.

items.name: Exterior house painting
items.blurb: Siding, trim and doors take the brunt of Georgia weather. One customer had us paint her entire exterior in four days. The split-level shown here has blue-gray siding with crisp white trim and porch posts, set off against the original red brick on the lower level.

items.name: Painted brick makeovers
items.blurb: Painting brick can change the whole look of a house. This before-and-after from our Google profile shows a two-story red brick home repainted in a soft light gray, with black shutters and white garage doors that now stand out for a clean, updated front.

image.alt: Before and after of a two-story home: red brick in the top photo, the same house painted light gray with black shutters below

items.blurb: Choosing colors is easier with help. Damien B. says Chris was insightful about how colors would look in different areas based on lighting and location, and receptive to the family's own ideas. We repaint single rooms, hallways and whole interiors, including homes recovering from a flood.

about.text: C4 Renovations, LLC is a general contractor in Buford, Georgia, led by Chris, the name customers mention in every review. Most of what they describe is painting: an interior repainted after a flood, a whole exterior finished in four days, a basement that now looks brand new, and color choices planned around each room's light. Customers call Chris professional, knowledgeable, insightful and patient, and say he communicates throughout the job. The line on his business cards sums up the goal: let me make your home look new again. We are open every day from 8 AM to 6 PM.
about.owner_role: Named in every review; the business cards in the Google photos read 'Chris Mcgee, Home Fixologist' and the email starts with christopher@; full name and title to confirm

items.name: Deborah A.
items.text: C4 Renovations has done a truly amazing job transforming my home. Last year, he repainted the inside of my home after a flood. He was professional, knowledgeable and had great customer service and fair pricing. This year, I needed to have the outside of the house painted, so I called on Chris again. He came through!!! He painted the entire house in 4 days, communicated throughout the process and did an amazing job. I'll continue to use C4 Renovations and Chris for all my home projects. Highly recommend!!

items.name: Damien B.
items.text: Great experience. Chris was amazing to work with. He was insightful on how colors would look in different areas based on lighting and location. He was also receptive to our suggestions and patient with our changes. He produced a great product in the timeline he originally identified. Definitely plan to work with him again.

items.name: Kristen S.
items.text: Chris and his team did a wonderful job painting our basement. It looks like a brand new area, and we can’t wait until they make the rest of our 20+ year old home look brand new as well! Pricing was fair and payment options were provided. We look forward to the next project! Highly recommended!

service_area.text: C4 Renovations, LLC works with homeowners in Buford, Georgia. If you live nearby and want to know whether your home is in our range, call (678) 328-8748 any day between 8 AM and 6 PM. Tell us where you are and whether you need interior painting, exterior painting, a basement refresh or another renovation, and we will let you know.

items.q: Do you paint both interiors and exteriors?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner had Chris repaint the inside of her home after a flood, then called him back the following year to paint the outside. He painted the entire house in four days and communicated throughout the process. We also paint basements and individual rooms.

items.q: Can you help me choose colors?
items.a: Yes. A customer says Chris was insightful about how colors would look in different areas of the house based on lighting and location, and receptive to the family's suggestions. Bring your ideas, and we will help you see how they will look in your own rooms.

items.q: How long will the job take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the home and the work, and Chris will give you a timeline before we start. One customer says he delivered a great product within the timeline he originally identified, and a full exterior repaint for another homeowner took four days.

One family who had their basement painted says the pricing was fair and payment options were provided. Ask about payment options when we talk through your project and price, and we will go over what is available for your particular job.

We are open seven days a week, from 8 AM to 6 PM, including Saturday and Sunday. Call (678) 328-8748, or email christopher@c4renovation.com with a few photos of the rooms or the outside of the house you want painted, and we will reply with next steps.

final_cta.h2: Ready to make your home look new again?
final_cta.text: Call Chris to talk about colors, timing and price for your painting project.
